_comment: Documented exceptions for scripts/ci/audit-gate.mjs. An entry tolerates ONE advisory (by GHSA id) and stops working after `expires`, which turns the pipeline red again so someone must re-decide. Adding or extending an entry needs the owner's approval; record the reason. Only high severity can be allowed: critical findings can never be allowlisted.

allow.reason: Memory exhaustion when validating oversized constrained collections. Fix needs zod 3 -> 4, a major upgrade the owner deferred (docs/ops/dependency-remediation.md). Low reachability: request bodies are size-capped.

DoS in JaegerPropagator via crafted trace headers. Fix needs @opentelemetry/sdk-node 0.55 -> 2.x, deferred by the owner. Unreachable by default: only the W3C propagator is enabled and OTEL_PROPAGATORS=jaeger is not set.
